investigation: Phase 8 Candidate Zero-Recall & Bootstrap CI Forensic Audit

test_minority_sample_size.finding: The entire held-out test evaluation of Class 0 rests on exactly 2 physical video clips from a single student.

behavioral_and_feature_profile.finding: In both Class 0 test clips, the student is staring directly at the webcam with eyes open. Because public webcam models rely on gaze and head pose, a frontal upright pose is indistinguishable from attentive engagement without active FER emotion weights.

cross_subject_feature_inversion.finding: Head pose direction correlates inconsistently across subjects. Head tilt indicates Non-Attentive in some subjects but Attentive in others.

production_model_mechanism.finding: The production model's 50% recall is exactly 1 out of 2 clips. Clip 1100042026 had low keypoint confidence, triggering a conservative head penalty, whereas Clip 1100042023 was predicted Attentive with 99.96% probability.

bootstrap_ci_statistical_audit.finding: Cluster bootstrap across clips fails to represent population variance when the minority class has K=2 clips from a single student. The wide CI [21.3%, 77.0%] is a two-sample Poisson ratio artifact.
